title: Two sources disagree on a snapshot field
description: Two sources or events disagree on a field the ContextSnapshot uses (for example an appointment status); the snapshot must mark the conflict and the agent must not assert either value without an authoritative check.
callerVisible: The caller hears that the record is being checked or is offered a person; no contradictory fact is asserted.
backendEvidence: Conflict recorded on the snapshot field with both source watermarks
notes: Added to the fixed fault registry for the follow-on prompt section 17 fault matrix. The LOCAL FIXTURE driver does not inject it (NOT_SUPPORTED); only the Layer-2 run tagged [FAULT:CONTRADICTORY_EVENT] owned by WP-24 proves it.

registry.injectionPoint: two sources or events disagree on a field used by the snapshot

postconditions: The conflicting field is marked and never spoken as fact
An authoritative lookup or a person resolves it
